browser.note: Separate invocations: historical broad baseline and shell scope, secondary review, and final 162-case navigation/recovery scope. No single full current-inventory invocation is claimed.

secrets.scope: Read-only all-local-ref history plus current tracked/nonignored untracked file snapshot. Default rules, decoded text depth 5, no baseline/rule/path exclusions or inline suppression. Ignored local credentials/dependencies/caches, archive contents and image OCR are outside the source scan. Findings are redacted; only exact reviewed source-line hashes may pass as non-secrets. Not proof that no secret could exist.

performance.scope: Isolated loopback static production build, gzip-negotiated HTML/JS/CSS/JSON/SVG, anonymous allowlisted reads to local API only; HTTPS requests blocked, no account or writes/provider sends. Lighthouse default simulated mobile and desktop presets; measurements must run without competing browser/build/coverage load. Compression models a required hosting delivery setting, not evidence that it is deployed. Lab LCP/CLS/TBT and accessibility only; TBT is not INP and these runs do not certify field p75 INP/LCP, representative 3D hardware or hosted latency. Raw reports in ignored artifacts/performance.
